name: Robinhood Markets, Inc.
description: Robinhood operates a commission-free retail brokerage platform offering equities, options, cryptocurrency, and margin lending. It generates revenue through payment for order flow, margin interest, Robinhood Gold subscriptions (4.3M subscribers as of Q1 2026), and its securities lending program. The company went public in July 2021.
notes: Key revenue streams: net interest income on margin loans, Gold subscription fees ($5/mo), payment for order flow, and share lending. Margin rates are tiered and discretionary, not benchmark-linked. Customer agreement revised April 10, 2026.
